# llm-provider-kit

> 108 LLM providers / 7 agent runtimes as plain JSON. Generate a provider configuration UI for any project without cloning this repo.

## Data
- https://lawson2019.github.io/llm-provider-kit/data/providers.json
- https://lawson2019.github.io/llm-provider-kit/data/agents.json
- https://lawson2019.github.io/llm-provider-kit/data/tiers.json

## Skill

- https://github.com/lawson2019/llm-provider-kit/tree/main/skills/llm-provider-kit
